name: 22_nbody_simulation
description: N-body simulation of the outer solar system (Sun + Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) over 50_000 integration steps. Uses the canonical Computer Language Benchmarks Game initial conditions so the energy invariant is comparable to published implementations. Hot loop is pair-wise gravitational force calculation through slice-of-struct field reads / writes (struct-of-arrays on Tengo). Exercises piko's struct-in-typed-slice path under FP load: a workload signature no other bench in this suite covers. Allows math.Sqrt / math.sqrt as a single IEEE 754 intrinsic; bans every other math import and any SIMD or numpy-style short-cut. Output is the integer-rounded energy_before and energy_after scaled by 1e9 so canonical hashing is FP-safe.
